dashboard.title: Subsystem Overview
dashboard.description: Pre-built time-series panels for every subsystem. Select a log file, then expand subsystem rows.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: time(v: "${file_start}"), stop: time(v: "${file_end}"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_type == "TalonFX")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal == "StatorCurrent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.file == "${file}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 200ms, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
